references.text: Previous instructions regarding the priests' use of shofars and the people's shouting during the seventh circuit around Jericho
Fulfillment of Joshua's command - the people shouted as the priests blew the shofars, and the walls fell
Use of shofars in battle as a sign of the Lord's deliverance and victory over enemies
Gideon's use of shofars and shouting in battle, leading to victory given by the Lord
Use of the shofar on the Day of Atonement in the seventh year, connecting the number seven with holy action
The letter to the Hebrews mentions that the walls of Jericho fell through faith after the Israelites had marched around the city for seven days
The sound of the shofar at Mount Sinai as a sign of God's presence and action
